gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko pad requires broad, intimate contact on clean, flat, smooth surfaces. An apple's curved geometry and natural skin texture prevent proper micro-contact for dry adhesion, making the gecko gripper infeasible and requiring maximum force.

silicone compliance conforms well to curved fruit geometry
